data.body: DIAGNOSIS COMPLETE (live, branch runs). Convergence trajectory 16->11->4->...->3 mutations/pass. Findings: (1) The two big classes (stale-binding-404, comment-fail) are eliminated. (2) The 'in-window field re-emitters' were dominated by REAL pending edits from this session's heavy ticket churn (8 tickets created/closed + many comments) — they CONVERGED once pushed (e.g. DIG-4933 changed=[description] resolved after a pass pushed it). NOT a code bug. (3) Permanent changed-field/comment-label breadcrumb shipped (commits 3183391c88/fabce24e6e) — any future residual is now diagnosable by field name + comment/label counts. (4) GENUINE RESIDUAL: one persistent comment re-emitter (DIG-5383, changed=[] comments=1) — a comment-BODY ADF round-trip mismatch (same class as 85a1/4175 but for comment bodies): local body != adf_to_text(jira_comment_adf) because Jira re-renders the body server-side, so _diff_comments' membership test never matches and re-adds every pass. Deepest-layer fix requires a DESIGN DECISION (tolerant-compare vs synced-shadow vs precise value-capture-and-mirror) — raised to user.
